settings.heading: Hot Pepper Spread
settings.text: A sweet heat made from sun-ripened peppers, local honey, and just enough smoke.

settings.heading: Bold, bright, and balanced
settings.text: From pantry staple to crowd-pleaser, this spread brings a little sun to every bite.

settings.heading: Hot Pepper Spread
settings.text: Made with heirloom peppers, vinegar, and local honey for an addictive balance of sweet heat.

settings.heading: Meet the Taggart family
settings.text: We plant, harvest, and cook every batch on our family farm just outside Spokane, WA. The result? A fiery spread with the soul of the land.

settings.heading: Farm kitchen favorites
settings.text: Layer the spread onto biscuits, whisk into vinaigrettes, or mix with mayo for a fiery aioli.

settings.heading: Need a lot of jars?
settings.text: Reach out for wedding favors, corporate gifts, or store shelves.
